description: This file declares internal API functions for the Slap Object Proxy (slap_opo) component within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) system. It provides prototypes for functions related to setting object descriptors and creating new server proxy instances.

methods.name: SlapOpoSetObjDescriptor
methods.description: Sets the object descriptor for the Slap Object Proxy.

methods.name: SlapOpoNewSrvProxy
methods.description: Creates a new server proxy instance for the Slap Object Proxy.
